dogecoin.text: @MacnBTC The original Catcoin came out just weeks after Dogecoin and is undergoing a massive revival. The chain never stopped, Bitcoin scarcity parameters. Genesis block happened on the 100th anniversary of the passage of thd Federal Reserve Act.
